allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add simulation mode for offline robot control

Implements complete simulation mode allowing robot control and
recording/playback without physical hardware connected.

New features:
- SimulatedSerialManager: Mock serial layer with G-code parsing
- SimulatedSerialThread: QTimer-based polling (no hardware required)
- Instant position updates for fast waypoint recording
- Full RRF protocol compatibility (G0/G1/G28/M114/M119/M42/M112)
- Config flag USE_SIMULATION_MODE to toggle real/simulated hardware
- GUI automatically disables port selection in simulation mode
- Console displays simulation status on connection

Architecture:
- Drop-in replacements for SerialManager and SerialThread
- Zero changes needed to controllers, kinematics, or visualization
- Uses existing ConnectionManager dependency injection
- Position recording and CSV playback work identically

Files:
- simulated_hardware.py: New simulated hardware layer (530 lines)
- config.py: Add USE_SIMULATION_MODE flag
- bifrost.py: Conditional hardware instantiation based on config

Testing:
- Successfully launches without hardware (verified in logs)
- SimulatedSerialManager initializes correctly
- Port selection disabled in simulation mode
- Ready for slider testing and CSV recording/playback
EOF
)")
